_readme: Hand-labeled real headlines for measuring server/quality.js classifyQuality accuracy. Built 2026-08-03. 'tune' is for prompt/parameter iteration; 'holdout' is scored only once a change is ready to ship — never inspected while iterating. Drafted by Claude from a random DB sample, reviewed and corrected by the project owner.

tune.title: Adobe Acrobat Extension Flaw Let Malicious Sites Read WhatsApp Web Data
tune.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a now-patched vulnerability chain in the Adobe Acrobat Chrome extension that has over 314 million users, which, if exploited, could facilitate a silent hijack of a user's WhatsApp data.
tune.note: specific vuln chain, named and patched

tune.title: AI Agents Are a New Kind of Identity — and Most Organizations Aren't Ready
tune.summary: If you're handling AI agents like a service account or API token, consider yourself behind. AI agents need a fundamentally different approach.

tune.title: AI-found bugs aren't proving any easier to exploit despite the hype
tune.summary: VulnCheck says fewer than 2% of AI-assisted vulnerability discoveries have been weaponized, casting doubt on claims frontier models are handing attackers a major advantage
tune.note: analysis/trend piece debunking a claim, not a specific threat report; borderline vs intel since it cites a study

tune.title: As Global Conflicts Go Digital, Businesses Need Wartime Game Plans
tune.summary: The fate of a Ukrainian tax software company shows how modern cyber warfare can claim casualties far beyond the battlefield, and how businesses across the ocean still need to protect themselves.

tune.title: Balance Theory Raises $19 Million to Help Enterprises Manage Cybersecurity Investments
tune.summary: The funding round was led by SYN Ventures, with participation from existing investors DataTribe and TEDCO.

tune.title: Bing Images Flaws Let Crafted SVGs Run Commands as SYSTEM on Microsoft's Servers
tune.summary: A crafted SVG submitted to Bing's image search ran commands as NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM on Microsoft's production image-processing workers, and as root on the Linux machines in the same fleet.

tune.title: 'BusySnake' Infostealer Slithers Into Critical Infrastructure Networks
tune.summary: A threat group researchers call "Armored Likho" has gained access to government agencies and electrical power entities in Russia, Brazil, and Kazakhstan.
tune.note: named malware and actor, specific campaign

tune.title: Certighost Exploit Lets Low-Privileged Active Directory Users Impersonate a Domain Controller
tune.summary: Researchers H0j3n and Aniq Fakhrul published a working exploit on July 24 that lets a low-privileged Active Directory user obtain a certificate for a Domain Controller and authenticate as that machine.

tune.title: Chaos Ransomware Uses msaRAT to Route C2 Traffic Through Headless Chrome and Edge
tune.summary: The Chaos ransomware group ran its command-and-control through the victim's own browser. Cisco Talos on Thursday detailed msaRAT, the Rust implant behind it.
tune.note: named actor and malware, specific technique

tune.title: Claude Flaw Automatically Sends Malicious Prompts to AI Agents
tune.summary: When combined with another exploit, the "PromptFiction" vulnerability, which has been fixed, could have enabled an end-to-end attack on a targeted system.

tune.title: C'mon, just copy this text string and paste it into your macOS Terminal – it'll fix your computer, honest
tune.summary: Newly documented stealer ClickLock comes for the more trusting Mac user with spot of social engineering
tune.note: named stealer, specific technique; snarky headline but genuine threat content

tune.title: Coca-Cola Suspends US Fairlife Production Due to Ransomware Attack
tune.summary: The company has yet to determine the full scope, nature, and impact of the incident.

tune.title: Connecting AI agents to outside services explodes the risk radius
tune.summary: Connect all the things and watch what happens

tune.title: Critical Ruflo Flaw Lets Attackers Spawn Rogue AI Swarms
tune.summary: Unauthenticated attackers could send HTTP requests to an exposed endpoint to execute commands inside the MCP bridge container.

tune.title: DataBahn Raises $40 Million for Agentic Data Pipeline Management
tune.summary: The company will accelerate investments in R&D and product innovation to expand its agentic data control plane.

tune.title: Discern Security Raises $13 Million in Series A Funding
tune.summary: The company will invest in accelerating the development and adoption of its agentic platform.

tune.title: Dozens of Minnesota Water Utilities Targeted in Coordinated OT Attacks
tune.summary: State and federal agencies respond after intrusions disrupt automated controls at municipal water and wastewater utilities.

tune.title: EU 'Chat Control' snoopfest returns after vote to kill it falls short
tune.summary: Opponents won the count but missed the 360-seat threshold needed to stop the interim CSAM-scanning rule
tune.note: legislative/policy news with editorializing tone, no threat/breach/vuln/actor

tune.title: Frontier AI: The Genie's Out of the Bottle, but Where's the Rulebook?
tune.summary: Cutting-edge artificial intelligence models are deploying with more independence and less human oversight. Several state governments are trying to legislate transparency in their use.

tune.title: Frontier LLMs couldn't help Hugging Face fight off evil agents
tune.summary: Chinese open-weight model GLM 5.2 happily obliged
tune.note: analysis piece reacting to an already-reported incident, not the original report

tune.title: Gold Eagle Clearinghouse Targets Security Gap, But How Is Unclear
tune.summary: The White House launched Gold Eagle to coordinate vulnerability response in a new AI world, but multiple questions linger over how it's being implemented.
tune.note: analysis of a government initiative, skeptical framing

tune.title: Google Bets 'Agentic Defense' Strategy Can Outpace Attackers
tune.summary: Google Cloud incorporates key Wiz capabilities into an agentic defense platform to automate threat detection and remediation against AI attacks.

tune.title: Google Launches Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber AI to Find and Fix Software Vulnerabilities
tune.summary: Google's DeepMind on Tuesday announced the release of Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber, a specialized artificial intelligence (AI) model built atop 3.5 Flash.

tune.title: Guten Tag, Bonjour, Hola to Our European Cyber Defenders!
tune.summary: We're thrilled to unveil the latest evolution of Dark Reading's DR Global section — your go-to source for region-specific cybersecurity intelligence beyond North America.
tune.note: self-promotional editorial announcement about the outlet's own coverage, not a vendor product

tune.title: Headteacher had the most guessable username-password combo you could imagine
tune.summary: Schools often don't prioritize or understand cybersecurity
tune.note: light/snarky editorial framing over a minor specific failure, no real threat-intel value

tune.title: In Other News: OpenAI Open Source Tool, AWS Links Hacks to North Korea, Mythos Crypto Research
tune.summary: Noteworthy stories that might have slipped under the radar: parcel delivery company OnTrac hacked, Adobe patches, UK Department for Education loses 607,000 records.

tune.title: Interpol Leverages Global System to Curtail Fraud Payments
tune.summary: When a fraudulent transaction occurs, law enforcement agencies must work quickly to halt payments before cybercriminals cash out.
tune.note: general institutional/informational piece, no specific incident or actor named

tune.title: ISC Stormcast For Friday, July 17th, 2026
tune.summary: (c) SANS Internet Storm Center. https://isc.sans.edu Creative Commons Attribution-Noncommercial 3.0 United States License.
tune.note: podcast episode, matches the prompt's own example exactly

tune.title: ISC Stormcast For Tuesday, July 14th, 2026
tune.summary: (c) SANS Internet Storm Center. https://isc.sans.edu Creative Commons Attribution-Noncommercial 3.0 United States License.

tune.title: Is 'Tech-xit' Imminent? UK Steps Up Sovereignty Push Amid AI Strife
tune.summary: The US government's restrictions on Anthropic and OpenAI frontier models have intensified calls in the UK and other countries to reduce their reliance on US tech companies, with significant cyber implications.

holdout.title: Kimi K3 Agents Found Redis Zero-Days and Built RCE Exploit, Researchers Say
holdout.summary: Redis shipped seven security releases on July 23 after researchers published authenticated RCE PoCs for stock Redis 6.2.22, 7.4.9, 8.6.4, and 8.8.0.

holdout.title: Microsoft closes book on Nightmare Eclipse's RoguePlanet zero-day
holdout.summary: Weeks after the exploit code dropped, Redmond has finally ships a fix for the Defender zero-day

holdout.title: Microsoft Maps Three Salesforce Attack Paths Tied to a Year of ShinyHunters Activity
holdout.summary: Attackers whose methods line up with the data-extortion group ShinyHunters have spent the past year walking into corporate Salesforce environments without exploiting a single flaw in the platform.

holdout.title: Microsoft Unveils MAI-Cyber-1-Flash, Its First Cybersecurity AI Model
holdout.summary: The company claims MAI-Cyber-1-Flash tops Anthropic's Mythos and OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol in CyberGym testing.

holdout.title: Mythos Asks the Right Question. It Doesn't Answer It.
holdout.summary: AI is compressing exploit timelines. The real question isn't whether your vulnerability management playbook needs to change, it's which part of it you've been getting wrong all along.
holdout.note: editorial analysis of a product/trend, not the vendor's own announcement

holdout.title: Netherlands Seizes 800 Servers, Arrests 2 for Aiding Cyberattacks
holdout.summary: Authorities in the Netherlands have arrested the co-owners of two related Internet hosting companies for operating IT infrastructure used by Russia to carry out cyberattacks, influence operations and disinformation campaigns.
holdout.note: specific law-enforcement action against named infrastructure

holdout.title: New Agent Data Injection Attack Can Make AI Agents Misclick or Run Attacker Commands
holdout.summary: Ask an AI agent to summarize the reviews on a product page, and a single planted review can make it click "Buy Now" instead.

holdout.title: Operation BlueDash Deploys Level RMM and ScreenConnect via Fake Teams Update
holdout.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have flagged a Microsoft Teams-themed phishing campaign that employs "secure document" lures to deliver legitimate remote monitoring and management (RMM) tools.

holdout.title: Phishing Campaigns Targeting AI Solutions Providers
holdout.summary: Most phishing campaigns rely on the fact that the victim is afraid to loose "something": money, access to information ... I spotted some phishing emails that focus on AI services like ChatGPT.
holdout.note: specific campaign observed and described by the author

holdout.title: Progress orders emergency ShareFile server shutdown over mystery security threat
holdout.summary: Vendor insists there's no evidence of unauthorized access, but it's asking customers to take one of the most drastic precautions available

holdout.title: Ransomware Is Accelerating, but It's Not Because of AI
holdout.summary: Researchers pointed to fragmentation of the ransomware ecosystem, the emergence of new attackers, and expansion of attacks on less defended organizations.

holdout.title: Recent DShield SIEM Update
holdout.summary: The last update to the DShield SIEM was in Sep 2025 which contained some minor tweaks. This update currently is using ELK stack version 8.19.15, contains some additional dashboards and new logs.
holdout.note: release notes for the author's own tool

holdout.title: Secure Unix ancestor KSOS did type safety before Rust made it cool
holdout.summary: Modula-based source code resurfaces after nearly four decades
holdout.note: tech-history feature, not threat-related at all

holdout.title: Spur Raises $200 Million for IP Intelligence Platform
holdout.summary: The IP intelligence company will use the fresh investment to accelerate and scale its operations.

holdout.title: Swiss train maker tells ransomware crooks to get off at the next stop
holdout.summary: Stadler refuses $12.3M demand after thieves swipe technical data through supplier platform

holdout.title: The Morning After We Pull a Root of Trust, Nobody Owns It
holdout.summary: The most valuable move any security team can make is building a certificate and key inventory.

holdout.title: The most famous brand in physical security got pwned by ShinyHunters
holdout.summary: Hopefully the company secures houses better than it locks down SaaS systems

holdout.title: Thinking Fast and Slow in the SOC: The Case for Combining Autonomous AI with Analyst Copilots
holdout.summary: A few days ago, I was sitting with the CISO of a Fortune 50 company, walking through how his security team was thinking about AI agents in the SOC.

holdout.title: ThreatLocker Raises $190 Million in Series F Funding
holdout.summary: The company was previously valued at $1.6 billion, and the latest raise has significantly increased that valuation.

holdout.title: ThreatsDay: AI-Powered Hacking, 370 Chrome Flaws, SonicWall Attacks, DNS Hijacking + 22 More Stories
holdout.summary: A lot of security still comes down to trusting the wrong screen. This week, that screen might be a login page, an install guide, a recruiter call, or a familiar service behaving slightly wrong.
holdout.note: weekly digest of many unrelated stories

holdout.title: ThreatsDay: Android Spyware, PLC Attacks, AI Image Prompt Injection + 12 More Stories
holdout.summary: Most of this week's trouble came dressed as something useful. A package stole data. A fake extension opened remote access. A safety app became spyware.

holdout.title: ThreatsDay: Game Cheat Spyware, 24-Hour Ransomware, Chrome Sync Stalking + 12 More Stories
holdout.summary: A lot of this week's trouble starts with something that looks close enough. A familiar repo. A useful installer. A harmless sync setting.

holdout.title: Turning the Tables on Email Scammers With 'ScamBuster'
holdout.summary: An open source, AI-driven system adopts victim personas to engage with phishing attackers, allowing organizations and law enforcement to gather relevant data on cybercriminal operations.
holdout.note: feature story on a research project, not vendor marketing and not a specific threat report; closest available fit

holdout.title: TuxBot v3 Evolution Shows Signs of LLM-Assisted IoT Botnet Development
holdout.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a previously unreported Internet-of-Things (IoT) botnet framework dubbed TuxBot v3 Evolution.

holdout.title: Unpatched Shark Vacuum Flaw Could Let Attackers Control Other Vacuums Region-Wide
holdout.summary: Pull the certificate off the flash of a Shark RV2320EDUS robot vacuum, and you can run root commands on other people's Shark vacuums across the same AWS region.

holdout.title: ⚡ Weekly Recap: Rogue AI Agents, Check Point Exploit, Slopsquatting, ClickFix Lures and More
holdout.summary: Monday starts with the usual promise that everything is under control. Then the logs wake up. This week, trusted tools crossed lines, old flaws found new work.

holdout.title: ⚡ Weekly Recap: ShareFile Threat, Citrix Bleed 2 Ransomware, AI Coding Attacks, and More
holdout.summary: Somewhere right now, a security tool is quietly finding bugs faster than any human can fix them. That's supposed to be the good news.

holdout.title: 20+ Hijacked Government Websites Became an Attack Channel
holdout.summary: More than 20 Brazilian government websites were hijacked and turned into malware delivery channels in an active PhantomEnigma campaign uncovered by ANY.RUN.
